description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of ResourcesModifiedStrategy when a resource is created within policy management. It tests the correct application of resource modifications in policy objects in response to specific events.

classes.name: ResourcesModifiedStrategyCreateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for ResourcesModifiedStrategy, testing resource creation events in policy objects.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Returns an instance of the ResourcesModifiedStrategy to be tested.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Creates a ResourcesModified event indicating a resource creation, used in tests.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Performs assertions verifying that the policy has been correctly updated with the new resource and removed resources, after applying the event.
